rules.statement: A party cannot acquire prescriptive title to an undivided portion of land.
rules.supporting_quote: when admittedly the 1st Plaintiff said that Reja Nona was in possession for well over 50 years and in the Plan No. 5788 marked 181 the eastern boundary is the defendants' land marked lot 2 in Plan marked 'X' which was proved by the Defendants by taking a commission and submitting the Plan No. 1054 where it is clearly stated that Lot 3 in that Plan is Lot 2 in Plan marked X' and also all the improvements and plantation were possessed by the Defendants?
